newsitem.title: CHILE: Santander upgrades Chile bottler Andina.
newsitem.headline: Santander upgrades Chile bottler Andina.

text.p: Santander Investment said is has upgraded Chilean bottler Embotelladora Andina SA to market perform from underperform, citing a sharp increase in earnings expected next year from its Argentine division.
In Chile, the company should benefit from strong soft drink industry gowth, said the report.
But in Rio de Janeiro, weak beverage growth and stiff competition remain concerns, it added.
Santander maintained its earnings per ADR of $0.77 this year and increased its 1998 estimate to $0.91 from $0.87.
